mapper.sql: p.id, NVL(pi.title, p.title) AS title, NVL(pi.summary, p.summary) AS summary, NVL(pi.eligibility, p.eligibility) AS eligibility, NVL(pi.deadline_text, p.deadline_text) AS deadline_text, NVL(pi.method_text, p.method_text) AS method_text, NVL(pi.notice, p.notice) AS notice, p.situation, p.phase_code, p.revision, p.region_id, p.category_id, r.name AS region_name, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_DOCUMENT d_count WHERE d_count.procedure_id = p.id) AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JL_STEP s_count WHERE s_count.procedure_id = p.id) AS step_count
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.id) AS rn FROM WHERE ) WHERE rn > #{offset} AND rn <= #{endRow} ORDER BY rn
SELECT FROM WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.published = 'Y'

SELECT d.id, NVL(di.name, d.name) AS name, d.requirement, NVL(di.condition_text, d.condition_text) AS condition_text, NVL(dg.description, dgj.description) AS description, NVL(dg.preparation_note, dgj.preparation_note) AS preparation_note FROM JL_DOCUMENT d LEFT JOIN JL_DOCUMENT_I18N di ON di.document_id = d.id AND di.language_code = #{language} LEFT JOIN JL_DOCUMENT_GUIDE dg ON dg.document_id = d.id AND dg.language_code = #{language} LEFT JOIN JL_DOCUMENT_GUIDE dgj ON dgj.document_id = d.id AND dgj.language_code = 'ja' WHERE d.procedure_id = #{id} ORDER BY d.display_order

SELECT s.step_no, NVL(si.title, s.title) AS title, NVL(si.description, s.description) AS description FROM JL_STEP s LEFT JOIN JL_STEP_I18N si ON si.step_id = s.id AND si.language_code = #{language} WHERE s.procedure_id = #{id} ORDER BY s.step_no

SELECT s.id, NVL(si.title, s.title) AS title, s.url, TO_CHAR(s.checked_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS checked_on, TO_CHAR(s.updated_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updated_on FROM JL_SOURCE s LEFT JOIN JL_SOURCE_I18N si ON si.source_id = s.id AND si.language_code = #{language} WHERE s.procedure_id = #{id} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT NVL(oi.name, o.name) AS name, o.address, o.homepage_url, NVL(oi.note, o.note) AS note FROM JL_OFFICE o JOIN JL_PROC_OFFICE po ON po.office_id = o.id LEFT JOIN JL_OFFICE_I18N oi ON oi.office_id = o.id AND oi.language_code = #{language} WHERE po.procedure_id = #{id} ORDER BY o.id
